name: website
description: Browser-chrome pane that loads an arbitrary URL in a sandboxed iframe. Editable URL bar (submit to navigate), refresh, and open-in-new-tab. Use for embedding external pages alongside generated content. Many sites set X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors and will refuse to load; the open-in-tab button is the fallback. Only http(s) URLs (or a path on the surface) load — javascript:, data:, blob: and file: are refused. Params: { url?: string, title?: string }.
